creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-06 on Muster 0.23.0 and Codex 0.166.0. `pane wait --until idle,done,blocked` returned `done`, then `pane send "/clear" --enter` was refused on the pane's screen: "'/clear' is disabled while a task is in progress." The send gave no sign of it. The same send a minute later worked.

Hold `done` until the harness can take a command, or have `pane send --confirm` fail when the screen refuses. Whether `--confirm` already catches this is not known: the reporter's pipeline hid its exit status.
title: A Codex pane reads done before Codex accepts /clear
